pages.menu_path: About Us > Our History > Our  History
pages.title: Our  History
pages.text_en:
The history of Simanjiro can be viewed in two main aspects: the origin of its name and its administrative development into a full district.
Below is a summary of that history:
(1) Origin of the Name “Simanjiro”
The name originates from the Maasai (Maa) language, which is the main ethnic group in the area. It comes from the word “Simanjiro,” meaning “an area with plenty of grass” or “a place for grazing.”
It is said that this area had many cattle keepers (the Maasai), and this characteristic of owning large herds led to the area being given this honorable name, symbolizing wealth in livestock.
(2) Administrative History
Before 1995: The Wanging’ombe area was part of Kiteto District within Manyara Region.
Establishment of the District: Simanjiro District was officially established in March 1995 (and became fully operational in 1996). This followed a government decision to divide Kiteto District.
Headquarters: The district headquarters are located in the town of Orkesumet.
(3) People and Culture
Ethnic Groups: The main inhabitants of Simanjiro are the Maasai. However, due to historical and geographical interactions, there are also significant numbers of Pare, Chagga, and Rangi people.
Economic Activities: Historically and up to the present, the people of Simanjiro are well known for cattle keeping and farming crops such as maize, beans, and sunflower.
If you want, I can also help refine it into a more formal report or academic format.
pages.text_sw:
Halmahauri ya Wilaya ya Simanjiro ni moja ya Halmashauri chache kongwe zenye utajiri na historia ambayo imechangia kuleta mabadiliko kisiasa, kiuchumi na kijamii Nchini.
Halmahauri ya Wilaya ya Simanjiro ina eneo la ukubwa wa kilomita za mraba 20,591 iliundwa 1996 chini ya sheria ya Serikali za mitaa (mamlaka ya miji) ya mwaka1982.
Halmahauri ya Wilaya ya Simanjiro ipo kusini mwa mkoa wa Dodoma ambapo Mashariki inapatikana na Wilaya ya Kilindi, Kusini inapakana na wilaya ya Kondoa iliyopo mkoa wa Dodoma na Kaskazini imepakana na Wilaya ya Arusha.
Simanjiro ina jimbo moja la uchaguzi (Jimbo la Simanjiro) lenye idadi ya watu ni 178,693 kati yao wanawake ni 89,791 na wanaume ni 89,791.
Historia ya Simanjiro inaanza kutazamwa katika sura kuu mbili: chimbuko la jina lake na mabadiliko ya kiutawala hadi kuwa wilaya kamili.
Hapa kuna muhtasari wa historia hiyo:
(1). Chimbuko la Jina "Simanjiro"
Jina hili linatokana na lugha ya Kimasai , ambalo ni kabila kuu la eneo hilo. Asili yake ni neno " Simanjiro " likimaanisha "Eneo lenye nyasi nyingi au mahali pa Malisho" .
· Inasemekana kuwa eneo hili lilikuwa na wafugaji wengi wa ng'ombe (wamasai), na sifa hiyo ya kumiliki mifugo mingi ikafanya eneo hilo kuitwa kwa jina hilo la heshima kwa matajiri wa mifugo.
(2). Historia ya Kiutawala
· Kabla ya mwaka 1984: Eneo la Wanging'ombe lilikuwa sehemu ya Wilaya ya Kiteto ndani ya Mkoa wa Manyara .
· Kuanzishwa kwa Wilaya: Wilaya ya Simanjiro ilianzishwa rasmi mnamo Machi 1995 (na kuanza kufanya kazi kikamilifu mwaka 1996). Hii ilitokana na uamuzi wa Serikali wa kugawa Wilaya ya Simanjiro.
· Makao Makuu: Makao makuu ya wilaya hii yapo katika mji mdogo wa Orkesumet .
(3). Watu na Utamaduni
· Makabila: Wakazi wakuu wa Simanjiro ni Wamasai . Hata hivyo, kutokana na muingiliano wa kihistoria na kijiografia, kuna idadi kubwa ya Wapare,wachaga na warangi .
· Shughuli za Kiuchumi: Kihistoria na hadi leo, watu wa Simanjiro ni maarufu kwa ufugaji wa ng’ombe na kilimo cha mahindi,maharage na alizeti

pages.title: Mission
pages.text_en:
Our Mission is To deliver efficient, accountable, and inclusive public services through effective use
of available resources; upholding good governance; and partnering with communities
and stakeholders
pages.text_sw: Dira yetu ni Kutoa huduma bora kwa wananchi kwa kutumia kwa usahihi rasilimali zilizopo na kukuza utawala bora na ushirikiano katika jamii.

pages.menu_path: About Us > Mission and Vision > Vission
pages.title: Vission
pages.text_en:
Our Vission is To be A trusted and well-governed council with quality social services and sustainable
community development.
pages.text_sw: Dhima yetu ni kuwa taasisi inayoaminika na yenye uthabiti kwa kutoa huduma bora kwa jamii

pages.menu_path: About Us > Core Value > Core  values
pages.title: Core  values
pages.text_en:
In executing its mandate and pursuing its Vision and Mission, the Simanjiro District
Council shall be guided by the following core values:
Integrity and Ethical Conduct
• Upholding honesty, fairness, impartiality, and professionalism in all decisions
and actions;
Professionalism and Competence
• Demonstrating technical excellence, diligence, innovation, and continuous
learning in service delivery
Transparency and Accountability
• Ensuring openness, responsibility, and prudent management of public
resources, with clear reporting and answerability;
Inclusiveness and Equity
• Promoting participation of all stakeholders, including women, youth, and
vulnerable groups, in development processes
Excellence
• We achieve highest standards in everything we do.
Team Work and Collaboration
• Fostering a culture of cooperation, mutual respect and partnership among staff,
stakeholders as well as partners and donors to positivel impact our activities.
Innovation
• Encouraging creativity, adoption of appropriate technologies and continuous
improvement of systems and process.

pages.text_sw:
Mikakati Yetu
 Kufanya uhamasishaji na uelimishaji wa jamii kuhusu kinga na udhibiti wa VVU/UKIMWI.
 Kuimarisha mipango na udhibiti wa matumizi ya fedha; kuongeza kiwango cha utekelezaji wa bajeti.
 Kuimarisha mifumo ya mwitikio wa uokoaji wakati wa majanga.
 Kuboresha utawala na huduma za kiutawala.
 Kuboresha ustawi wa jamii, usawa wa kijinsia na uwezeshaji wa jamii.
 Kuongeza ubora na wingi wa huduma za kijamii na kiuchumi.
 Kuboresha miundombinu ya shule.
 Kuongeza uandikishaji wa wanafunzi shuleni.
 Kuboresha ustawi wa walimu.
 Kuimarisha programu za upandaji miti (urejeshaji wa misitu).
 Kutoa uhamasishaji kuhusu ufugaji nyuki.
 Kuimarisha mafunzo na msaada kwa wajasiriamali na biashara ndogo, za kati na ndogo sana (MSMEs).
 Kukuza miundombinu wezeshi katika maeneo maalum ya viwanda.
 Kufanya ukarabati, usajili, ujenzi na matengenezo ya miundombinu ya michezo, sanaa na utamaduni.
 Kukuza na kuendeleza vipaji vya michezo na sanaa miongoni mwa vijana na jamii.
 Kuboresha maendeleo ya miundombinu na utoaji wa huduma.
 Kuboresha miundombinu ya barabara.
 Kuendeleza miundombinu ya kilimo.
 Kuboresha utoaji wa huduma za ugani wa kilimo.
 Kuboresha muundo wa shirika na usimamizi wa taasisi.
 Kuongeza uwazi na mawasiliano ya umma yenye kuwajibika.
 Kuimarisha utawala wa kielektroniki (e-Governance) na matumizi ya teknolojia.
Ukitaka, naweza pia kukusaidia kuipanga katika makundi (mfano: afya, elimu, miundombinu, uchumi) ili iwe rasmi zaidi kwa ripoti au mpango wa maendeleo.
